entities.summary:
Virrat is a town and municipality of Finland. Part of the Pirkanmaa region, it is located 104 kilometres (65 mi) north of Tampere and 113 kilometres (70 mi) west of Jyväskylä. Virrat is 285 kilometres (177 mi) from Helsinki. The town has a population of 6,124
(31 December 2025) and covers an area of 1,299.07 square kilometres (501.57 sq mi) of
which 136.73 km2 (52.79 sq mi)
is water. The population density is
5.27 inhabitants per square kilometre (13.6/sq mi). The municipality is unilingually Finnish.
